movie.title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
movie.overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When Marge discovers Homer left their children home alone with only a smart doorbell to watch them, a night out turns tense as she imagines alternate, idealized versions of her husband.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Homer and Marge's romantic date night takes a sharp turn when Marge realizes the kids were left completely unsupervised at home. Upset by Homer's ongoing negligence and lack of responsibility, a slightly intoxicated Marge begins to resent his flaws. To cope with her frustration, she slips into a series of vivid fantasies reimagining what life would be like with different versions of Homer. Through these imaginative scenarios, she explores both the allure of perfection and the reality of her marriage.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Homer and Marge head out for what is supposed to be an enjoyable couples' date night, hoping for a rare evening of relaxation away from family chaos. However, the mood collapses when Marge accidentally discovers that Homer left their children completely unattended, relying solely on a ring doorbell camera as an automated babysitter. Furious and deeply disappointed by his reckless shortcut, Marge finds herself questioning Homer's maturity and commitment as a partner. As the evening wears on and the alcohol flows, her frustration bubbles over into an active imagination. She begins visualizing a trilogy of alternate realities, each featuring a radically transformed version of Homer tailored to fix his obvious shortcomings. In one fantasy, he is a sleek, highly competent professional; in another, an endlessly romantic gentleman; and in another, an attentive, hyper-responsible provider. Yet, as each fantasy plays out, Marge starts to notice that these 'upgraded' husbands come with their own distinct flaws and unexpected drawbacks. By cycling through these imagined lives, she is forced to weigh the charm of ideal fantasy against the chaotic reality of the man she actually married. Ultimately, the night transforms from a marital spat into a quirky exploration of acceptance, love, and the flaws that make their relationship unique.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A night out for Homer and Marge Simpson unravels after Marge discovers Homer's questionable parenting tactics—leaving the kids home alone under the watchful eye of a doorbell camera. Spurred by alcohol and exasperation, Marge escapes into a trilogy of creative fantasies featuring alternate takes on Homer, testing whether a 'better' husband would truly make for a better life.

story_structure.resolution: Marge processes her frustrations through her exaggerated fantasies, coming to terms with her marriage and her imperfect husband.
story_structure.introduction: Marge and Homer head out for a fun couples' date night, attempting to enjoy an evening away from their daily household responsibilities.
story_structure.risingAction: Frustrated by Homer's continuous shortcomings and fueled by alcohol, a tipsy Marge escapes into a series of imaginative fantasies envisioning alternative, modified versions of her husband.
